name: A Word at the Right Time

system.description:
FLOURISH FOLKWARDEN

Experience is most useful when it reaches someone a moment before they make the mistake.
Action Reaction; Trigger An ally within 30 feet attempts a skill check that you could reasonably assist using Practical Counsel.
You may immediately make the appropriate Aid check using Practical Counsel, even if you had not previously declared that you were assisting.
Your advice must be capable of being communicated quickly enough to matter. If it is verbal, the ally must be able to hear and understand you.
This feat cannot be used with Aid Offensive, Aid Defensive or to substitute knowledge for an attack roll.

Prerequisites Level 5, Practical Counsel

A rule for the table: Aid as a Reaction through Practical Counsel.
